pages.description: A photograph taken through a spacecraft window showing the curved limb of Earth against the black of space on the left half of the frame; the planet's surface appears as blue and white cloud-covered ocean and atmosphere. The right half of the image is dominated by a dark window frame and interior structures, with reflections and glare visible on the glass. A small white triangular shape floats near the center. In the lower right corner a partial reflection of a human face is faintly visible. The film frame has red numeric markers along the left edge.

observations.claim: The curved edge of a planet is visible on the left portion of the image
Blue and white cloud patterns cover the visible planet surface
A dark window frame occupies the right side of the frame
Red numeric characters appear along the left edge of the frame
A partial human face reflection is faintly visible in the lower right corner
A small white triangular shape is near the center of the image
